levels.name: NOMINAL PATROL
levels.description: Routine scheduled waypoint transit. Sensor optical flow within baseline parameters. No anomalies flagged.
levels.actionRequired: Continuous telemetry logging, regular heartbeats to Ground Control Station.

levels.name: PERSISTENCE ANOMALY / CROWD ACCUMULATION
levels.description: Measurable pedestrian or vehicular cluster count exceeds historical temporal density threshold (+42% over baseline for >180s).
levels.actionRequired: Automated camera gimbal hold on coordinate centroid; alert queued in GCS console for human review.

levels.name: POSSIBLE VEHICULAR INCIDENT
levels.description: Abrupt deceleration vector followed by perpendicular traffic lane occlusion and spatial stagnation.
levels.actionRequired: GCS alert notification with optical crop and geo-coordinates; human operator confirms or dismisses.
evidenceFields: Occlusion metric: 2 lanes obstructed on Ring Road Outer Sector

levels.name: CRITICAL THERMAL / COMBUSTION SIGNATURE
levels.description: Localized rapid IR temperature delta > 120°C above ambient baseline, accompanied by optical luminance bloom and smoke plume dispersal.
levels.actionRequired: Immediate high-priority audible tone at Ground Control Station; automated coordinate dispatch package generated for human authorization.
evidenceFields: Spatial dispersion rate: 1.6 m²/s plume growth
